text:
pagerbot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired for service=svc-inference-gateway (PD key: PD-87321). Error-rate spike: 502/503s > 5% in eu-west1 across edge-gateway nodes. Auto-escalation in 5m if unacked.

oncall-alex: Acked. I'm on it — checking recent deploys and load. pinging SRE.

observability-bot: Alert summary:
- window: 2024-09-14T21:03:00Z - 21:09:00Z
- 5xx rate: 7.4% (baseline 0.3%)
- top upstream: edge-proxy (keepalive_closed=high)
- p50 latency: 120ms -> 340ms
- affected routes: /v1/generate, /v1/chat/stream

sre-maya: seeing a sharp spike in `keepalive_reuse` errors on the nginx fronting layer, lots of `upstream prematurely closed connection` in logs. Pulling pod logs now.

eng-li: any traffic shaping / rollout activity in the last 30m?

oncall-alex: @eng-li there was a canary roll 12m ago for `inference-gateway:release-2024-09-14`. Canary % = 10%.

eng-li: ok canary likely culprit. Can we scale canary down / kill canary pods? If it's connection handling change we need to stop the roll.

sre-maya: running `kubectl -n prod rollout status deploy/inference-gateway` -> `2/5 replicas ready (2 updated).` Also tailing logs:
```
2024-09-14T21:04:22Z edge-proxy-5 nginx: [error] upstream prematurely closed connection while reading response header from upstream
2024-09-14T21:04:23Z inference-gw-9 python: ConnectionResetError: socket.recv returned 0 bytes
```

oncall-alex: I'm going to pause the rollout and scale the old replicas back to 5. Triggering rollback.

eng-li: Command to rollback: `kubectl -n prod rollout undo deployment/inference-gateway --to-revision=42` — do it, and then monitor 5xx. Also open to swapping traffic to backup cluster if rollback doesn't reduce errors in 2m.

sre-maya: Rollback started. `kubectl scale deployment/inference-gateway --replicas=5 --namespace=prod`. Patch applied.

observability-bot: After rollback start: 5xx rate down to 4.9% (from 7.4%) within 45s. p50 down to 260ms.

oncall-alex: Good sign. Eng take: can we confirm root cause? Any change to `Connection: keep-alive` handling?

eng-li: quick diff shows a change in the HTTP connection pool code in the canary that disables `SO_KEEPALIVE` timeout tuning and reduces the max concurrent sockets per host. That can cause premature upstream closes under spike. We'll revert the pool change and re-run CI.

product-jamie: Customer-impact check: initial blast lasted ~6 minutes, approx 8% of API requests in eu-west1 saw 5xx. No billing anomalies flagged yet. Key customers: two high-priority customers saw elevated error rates (IDs redacted). We should notify CS with a summary.

oncall-alex: Notifying CS and PGs. Drafting short customer notification: "We experienced a brief increase in 5xx errors in eu-west1 between 21:03–21:10 UTC due to a canary deployment. We've reverted the change and are monitoring; functionality has been restored for the majority of traffic. Engineers investigating root cause and follow-up postmortem forthcoming." :mailbox_with_mail:

sre-maya: Metrics look stable for 3m: 5xx at 0.6% now, p50 130ms. I'll keep an eye for 15m.

eng-li: We'll mark cause as `regression: connection-pool-change` for now. Follow-ups: (1) add e2e test covering keepalive behavior under concurrency, (2) add a canary traffic shaping to limit connections-per-host, (3) revert pushed to main with hotfix.

oncall-alex: Handing off to night SRE. Taking notes for on-call log: rollback executed, customer notif drafted, monitoring OK.

sre-maya: Handoff acked by night oncall. Leaving runbook links: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/inference-gateway-5xx

observability-bot: Incident closed by auto-alert after thresholds cleared. Please file a postmortem if this impacted customers significantly.

product-jamie: Filing postmortem ticket now and assigning to eng-li + sre-maya.

eng-li: will follow up with root cause details and proposed mitigations. Thanks team. :heart:

oncall-alex: Closing thread.
